_about: App-tour reels ('Inside StreakChess'). Every line describes something that is really in the app (checked against the app itself on 2026-11-18). Screens are real screenshots from a demo account (assets/app/screens). Coordinates are fractions of the screenshot: focus = [y0, y1] or [x0, y0, x1, y1]; box = [x0, y0, x1, y1]; tap = [x, y]. Numbers in 'say' are written as words for the voice.
end_say: StreakChess. Free to start, for every level. Link in bio.

episodes.hook_say: This is StreakChess, the daily chess training app, in thirty seconds.

scenes.label: One small daily goal
scenes.say: You open it and get one small goal: solve three puzzles today.

scenes.label: A set built for you
scenes.say: It builds today's set for you. Twelve puzzles, aimed at your weakest theme.

scenes.label: Calculate, then move
scenes.say: Every puzzle is a real position with a clock. Calculate first, then play your move.

scenes.label: Instant feedback
scenes.say: Get it right and your rating climbs. Miss it, and Vektor shows you the idea you missed.

scenes.label: Keep the streak
scenes.say: Come back tomorrow and your streak grows. A few minutes a day. That's the whole trick.

question.label: Your longest streak?
question.say: What's the longest streak you have ever kept, in anything? Comment the number.
question.caption: What's the longest streak you've ever kept (in anything)? Comment the number 👇

takeaways: One small goal a day: 3 puzzles
A daily set of 12 puzzles aimed at your weakest theme
Instant feedback: rating up, or the idea you missed

episodes.hook_say: One chess rating hides your real weakness. StreakChess gives you three.

scenes.label: Fast · Pressure · Deep
scenes.say: Thirty seconds for reflexes. Three minutes for tournament pressure. Ten minutes for deep calculation.

scenes.label: Ten minutes, one position
scenes.say: In Deep Calculation you get ten minutes for a single position. No guessing. You have to see the whole line.

scenes.label: See your shape
scenes.say: Your profile draws the three ratings as a triangle, so the weak side is obvious.

scenes.label: Climb the leagues
scenes.say: The average of the three sets your league, from Bronze all the way up to Master.

question.label: Fast, pressure or deep?
question.say: Which one is your weakest: fast, pressure, or deep? Comment one word.
question.caption: Which is your weakest: FAST, PRESSURE or DEEP? Comment one word 👇

takeaways: ⚡ Tactical Reflexes: 30 seconds
⚔️ Tournament Pressure: 3 minutes
🧠 Deep Calculation: 10 minutes
Your league = the average of the three

episodes.hook: The 3 rules that keep you training
episodes.hook_say: StreakChess has three small rules. They are why people actually train every day.

scenes.label: Three hearts
scenes.say: You start with three hearts. A wrong answer costs one, and they refill on their own, one every four hours.

scenes.label: A daily shield
scenes.say: Your daily shield absorbs the first mistake of the day, before it costs you a heart.

scenes.label: An avatar that grows
scenes.say: And your avatar evolves as your streak grows. Keep the streak alive to level it up.

scenes.label: Three puzzles a day
scenes.say: All it takes is three solved puzzles a day.

question.label: 30 days: yes or no?
question.say: Could you keep a thirty day streak? Comment yes or no.
question.caption: Could you keep a 30-day streak? Comment YES or NO 👇

takeaways: ❤️ 3 hearts: a miss costs one, +1 every 4 hours
🛡️ A daily shield absorbs your first mistake
🔥 3 solved puzzles a day keep the streak alive

episodes.topic: My Mistakes: learn from every miss
episodes.hook: Your mistakes are your best coach
episodes.hook_say: The fastest way to get better at chess is hiding in your own mistakes.

scenes.label: Every miss is saved
scenes.say: StreakChess saves every puzzle you get wrong, with your move and the correct one.

scenes.label: See what you missed
scenes.say: Open one and the board shows you the right move, next to the move you played.

scenes.label: Try it again
scenes.say: Then you try it again for real, until the pattern sticks.

scenes.label: Know your weak theme
scenes.say: Over time you see exactly which themes cost you the most points.

question.label: Do you review your losses?
question.say: Be honest. Do you review the games you lose? Comment yes or no.
question.caption: Be honest: do you review the games you lose? YES or NO 👇

takeaways: Every wrong puzzle is saved with your move and the right one
Replay it until the pattern sticks
Accuracy by theme shows where your points go

hook_alt: What happens when you sign up
episodes.hook_say: Here is what your first three minutes on StreakChess look like.

scenes.label: Who is training?
scenes.say: First it asks who is training. Kids, teens, adults and seniors each get their own pace.

scenes.label: Pick your goal
scenes.say: Then your goal: unwind, sharpen your thinking, or climb the ratings.

scenes.label: Set your level
scenes.say: Tell it how strong you are. Beginners start with simple mates. Online players can use their rating.

scenes.label: Your starting profile
scenes.say: After a few calibration puzzles you get three starting ratings, and a plan for your weakest one.

question.label: Where would you start?
question.say: Where would you start: beginner, intermediate, or advanced?
question.caption: Where would you start: BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE or ADVANCED? 👇

takeaways: Built for kids, teens, adults and seniors
Beginners start with simple mates
A few calibration puzzles give you 3 starting ratings

episodes.topic: Arcade: Puzzle Blitz and Puzzle Survival
hook_alt: Two modes for a short break
episodes.hook_say: Got three minutes? StreakChess has two arcade modes for exactly that.

scenes.label: Puzzle Blitz
scenes.say: Puzzle Blitz. Three minutes, rising difficulty, and three strikes and you're out.

scenes.label: How far can you get?
scenes.say: The puzzles keep getting harder. Your score is how many you solve before the clock, or the strikes, stop you.

scenes.label: Puzzle Survival
scenes.say: Puzzle Survival starts with thirty seconds. A correct answer adds six. A miss takes eight away.

scenes.label: Then train for real
scenes.say: And when you want serious work, the three rated paces are one tap away.

question.label: Blitz or Survival?
question.say: Blitz or Survival: which one would you play first? Comment B or S.
question.caption: BLITZ or SURVIVAL: which would you play first? Comment B or S 👇

takeaways: ⏱️ Puzzle Blitz: 3 minutes, 3 strikes
⚡ Puzzle Survival: start with 30 s, +6 s per solve, −8 s per miss

episodes.topic: Tactical Hexcore: find your weak spot
episodes.hook: Find your weak spot in chess
episodes.hook_say: Every chess player has a weak spot. This screen shows you yours.

scenes.label: Six tactical dimensions
scenes.say: StreakChess tracks six tactical dimensions, from king attacks to endgame precision, and draws them as one shape.

scenes.label: Accuracy by theme
scenes.say: Below it, your accuracy in each one. The shortest bar is where your points are leaking.

scenes.label: Training aimed at it
scenes.say: Then your daily set is built around that weakest theme.

scenes.label: Or drill it yourself
scenes.say: Or open the sandbox, tap any corner of the hexagon, and drill just that.

question.label: Attack, defence or endgame?
question.say: What is your weakest area: attack, defence, or endgames? Comment it.
question.caption: What's your weakest area: ATTACK, DEFENCE or ENDGAMES? 👇

takeaways: 6 dimensions: King Assaults, Board Geometry, Piece Dynamics, Defensive Resilience, Endgame Precision, Forcing Lines
Your daily set targets the weakest one
The Hexagon Sandbox lets you drill any of them

episodes.hook_say: Training alone gets boring. So StreakChess gives you rivals.

scenes.label: Leagues
scenes.say: Your three ratings place you in a league, from Bronze to Master.

scenes.label: Your division
scenes.say: Inside it you see who is just above you. That is who you train to pass.

scenes.label: 1v1 puzzle duels
scenes.say: Or send five puzzles to a friend. They play first, then you try to beat them.

scenes.label: The leaderboard
scenes.say: And a leaderboard ranks the top hundred players by experience, puzzles, streak and rating.

question.label: Who would you challenge?
question.say: Tag the friend you would challenge to a puzzle duel.
question.caption: Tag the friend you'd challenge to a puzzle duel 👇

takeaways: 6 leagues, Bronze → Master, by the average of your 3 ratings
1v1 duels: send 5 puzzles to a friend
Leaderboard: top 100 by XP, puzzles, streak and rating

episodes.topic: The Weekly Quest and its Boss Fight
hook_alt: The hardest puzzle of the week
episodes.hook_say: Nine puzzles. One attempt. And a boss at the end.

scenes.label: The Weekly Quest
scenes.say: Every week StreakChess runs one quest, and everyone gets the same puzzles.

scenes.label: No second try
scenes.say: They get harder as you go, and you only get one shot at each.

scenes.label: The Boss Fight
scenes.say: The last one is the Boss Fight: a master level puzzle to close it out.

scenes.label: Win a streak shield
scenes.say: Finish in the top three of the week and you win a streak shield.

question.label: Could you beat the boss?
question.say: Would you survive the boss puzzle? Comment yes or no.
question.caption: Would you survive the Boss Fight? YES or NO 👇

takeaways: One quest a week, the same puzzles for everyone
9 puzzles, rising difficulty, one attempt each
Top 3 each week win a Streak Shield

episodes.hook: What a month of training looks like
hook_alt: The report card for your chess
episodes.hook_say: This is what a month of chess training looks like on paper.

scenes.label: A monthly report
scenes.say: StreakChess turns your training into a monthly report. This is the example report from the app.

scenes.label: The numbers that matter
scenes.say: Rating, accuracy, puzzles completed, your streak, and your median time per puzzle.

scenes.label: Your next focus
scenes.say: It names the one theme to work on next, and a strength you have actually measured.

scenes.label: Theme by theme
scenes.say: And it breaks your accuracy down theme by theme, against your previous period.

question.label: Which stat do you want?
question.say: Which number would you most want to see about your own chess?
question.caption: Which number would you most want to see about your own chess? 👇

takeaways: A report for every month of training (the one shown is the app's example report)
Rating, accuracy, puzzles, streak, time per puzzle
One theme to work on next

episodes.topic: XP, levels and the Avatar Store
episodes.hook_say: Chess study is hard to stick with. This is how StreakChess makes it stick.

scenes.label: Level up
scenes.say: Every solved puzzle earns experience. Fill the bar and you level up.

scenes.label: Spend it
scenes.say: That experience is also a currency for the avatar store. And your level never drops.

scenes.label: Legendary avatars
scenes.say: The rarest avatars are earned by the most dedicated solvers.

scenes.label: Achievements
scenes.say: And achievements track your training, your streaks, and your duels.

question.label: Dragon or Phoenix?
question.say: Dragon Knight or Phoenix Queen? Comment D or P.
question.caption: Dragon Knight or Phoenix Queen? Comment D or P 👇

takeaways: Every solved puzzle earns XP
Spend XP on avatars — your level never drops
Achievements for training, streaks and duels

hook_alt: How to train when you're busy
episodes.hook_say: Here is a ten minute daily chess routine you can do entirely on your phone.

scenes.label: 1 · Three from today's set
scenes.say: One. Solve at least three puzzles from today's set. That keeps your streak alive.

scenes.label: 2 · Fix one mistake
scenes.say: Two. Open one puzzle you got wrong, see the right move, and try it again.

scenes.label: 3 · One Blitz run
scenes.say: Three. Finish with one Puzzle Blitz run, to train your speed.

scenes.label: Done for today
scenes.say: Streak safe. In ten minutes you trained your weak theme, your memory, and your speed.

question.label: Morning or night?
question.say: When do you train: morning or night? Comment M or N.
question.caption: When do you train: MORNING or NIGHT? Comment M or N 👇

takeaways: 1. Three puzzles from today's set
2. Review one mistake and replay it
3. One Puzzle Blitz run
